notes: Original acquisition exhausted bounded open-access attempt: DOI landing page redirects to publisher; Unpaywall reports no OA location; OpenAlex reports no OA location or repository full text; Rotman author PDF YJESP2796.pdf and DeVoe and House, JESP.pdf paths returned 404; one alternative full-paper transcription at doczz returned 403 and was not retried. No full original paper obtained. Original statistics repeated in replication Table 1/2 were not substituted for independently inspected original text. Replication table locator identifies happiness for 715 and impatience for 716. Calculation × compensation interaction selected: the tables print an effect size for this test. Replication 1 interactions are statistically significant but the authors state their pattern is contrary to the original; reported_success reflects the authors’ narrative verdict. Verbatim table row quotes normalize whitespace. The original side remains unavailable independently of the completed replication side.
